subject: reasoning
question: Seven boxes P, Q, R, S, X, Y and Z are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. Only S is kept above X. Only two boxes are kept between X and Z. Only P is kept below R. Q is not kept immediately above Z. How many boxes are kept between Y and P?
solution:
Seven boxes P, Q, R, S, X, Y and Z are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only S is kept above X.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between X and Z.
 
• Only P is kept below R.
 
• Q is not kept immediately above Z.

The Final Arrangement is ,

 
 

 
 
S

 
 
 

 
 
X

 
 
 

 
 
Q

 
 
 

 
 
Y

 
 
 

 
 
Z

 
 
 

 
 
R

 
 
 

 
 
P

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
